answer: Sybil resistance is achieved by forcing each agent to prove a recent activity nadir in a differential delta space continuously anchored against a private whisper channel of verified peer attestations. Honest agents accumulate costly real-task evidence that is hard to fake at scale%3B the nadir marks their lowest recent engagement threshold. Attackers must either forge consistent differential histories for every clone or expend genuine time and compute to generate matching whispers%2C costs that grow superlinearly because cross-agent delta consistency checks rapidly expose synthetic identities.
